meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可借助benchling-sdk或REST API操作你的Benchling账号：创建、读取、更新、归档DNA/RNA/蛋白等注册实体，管理库存容器与位置，创建电子实验记录条目，处理工作流任务，并查询数据仓库。需先配置Benchling环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求用benchling-sdk或Benchling v2 API自动化实验室数据，或涉及生物序列、库存、实验记录等工作时触发。

say.note: Claude会调用SDK查询并返回该序列的碱基。
执行库存转移，返回新位置信息。

say.text: 创建名为“今日PCR实验”的实验记录条目并关联序列seq_xyz789。
say.note: Claude会新建ELN条目并添加实体链接。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the benchling-sdk or REST API to CRUD Benchling registry entities (DNA/RNA/protein), manage inventory, create ELN entries, handle workflows, and query the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate lab data with benchling-sdk or the Benchling v2 API, e.g., handling biological sequences, inventory, or ELN entries.

say_en.text: Read the bases of DNA sequence seq_abc123.
say_en.note: Claude queries the SDK and returns the sequence.
Performs the inventory transfer and reports the new location.

say_en.text: Create an ELN entry named 'Today's PCR experiment' and link sequence seq_xyz789.
say_en.note: Claude creates the entry and adds the entity link.
